title: RawArtifactEnvelope
description: Metadata envelope for a raw artifact stored in object storage. This is the contract between platform-control and document-intelligence.

artifact_id.description: Unique identifier for the artifact. Format: art_{ulid}

source_id.description: ID of the source that produced this artifact. Format: src_{ulid}

source_version_id.description: ID of the source version. Format: sv_{ulid}

run_id.description: ID of the run that produced this artifact. Format: run_{ulid}

storage_path.description: Object storage path (GCS URI) where the raw artifact is stored.

content_type.description: MIME type or format hint for the artifact.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the artifact was created.

metadata.description: Additional metadata from the run. Schema is intentionally open for extensibility.
